mechanism: On a 168-hour Unix-epoch schedule, form 252 contemporaneous eight-hour return pairs from exactly 253 past-closed prices for each A6-eligible native-crypto contract. At each timestamp use the cross-sectional median return as the common tape. Estimate separate conditional slopes on positive and negative common-tape bars, average-rank each slope, and set final long desirability to 0.50 times upside-capture rank minus downside-capture rank. Expose that complete finite score dictionary once to A5, then select equal-weight top and bottom sleeves in an exactly dollar-balanced 0.48-gross book.
economic_thesis: Deep, broadly held and collateral-useful native crypto assets can capture more of common market advances while transmitting less of common declines, whereas fragile leverage-sensitive assets can exhibit the opposite asymmetry. A convex-minus-concave spread can therefore support long-bull, short-bear, and alternating-move chop roles without predicting the sign of the next market move.

expected_regime_roles.bull: High-upside-capture, low-downside-capture contracts populate the long sleeve and should earn more of broad advances than the short sleeve surrenders.
expected_regime_roles.bear: High-downside-capture fragile contracts populate the short sleeve while resilient long contracts should lose less.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Repeated positive and negative common-tape moves should repeatedly favor the same convex-minus-concave spread without a directional forecast.
expected_regime_roles.stress: No crisis-alpha claim is made beyond measured downside-capture separation; broad equal sleeves, exact dollar balance, 0.48 gross, and 5% caps limit concentration without an optional risk overlay.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Top A5-returned scores with both higher median upside capture and lower median downside capture than the selected shorts; required to contribute positively in bull.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Bottom A5-returned scores with both lower median upside capture and higher median downside capture than the selected longs; required to contribute positively in bear.

falsifier: Reject the exact no-control UDCC core if it is insolvent, lacks required evidence, or fails any causality, A5, A6, return, Sharpe, cost, drawdown, Calmar, quarter, fold, trial-adjusted-confidence, regime, role, sleeve, concentration, conditional-common-tape, or score-IC gate in qualification_thresholds.json. Controls, sign flips, neighbors, and same-family replacements cannot rescue failure.
selection_metric: No within-family selection occurs: one exact no-control core is eligible only if every noncompensatory development, A5, regime, role, sleeve, concentration, and UDCC mechanism gate passes.
risk_policy_plan: Root risk_policy.json is byte-identical to risk_policies/no-control.json. No volatility target, drawdown brake, position or time stop, turnover control, side scaling, combined policy, ablation, parameter neighbor, or sign flip is authorized before or after the result.
